# The Memory Hierarchy in Anger: Matrix Transpose
On modern GPUs, moving data costs an order of magnitude more energy and latency than performing math.

### The Memory Ladder

| Memory Level | Location | Latency | Typical Bandwidth | Scope |
|--------------|----------|---------|-------------------|-------|
| Registers | On-chip | 0-1 cycles | ~20-30 TB/s | Single thread |
| Shared Memory (SRAM) | On-chip SM | ~20-30 cycles | ~10-15 TB/s | Thread block |
| L2 Cache | On-chip shared | ~200 cycles | ~3-5 TB/s | Entire GPU |
| Global DRAM (HBM/GDDR) | Off-chip | ~400-800 cycles | ~1-3 TB/s | Host & all grids |

### Coalescing: The ~10x Lever

When threads in a warp access global memory, the memory controller inspects their addresses:
- **Coalesced:** Threads 0..31 access sequential 4-byte words. The hardware serves all 32 threads in a single 128-byte cache line transaction (100% bus utilization).
- **Strided / Uncoalesced:** Each thread accesses a different cache line. The hardware issues 32 separate 128-byte transactions to fetch 128 bytes of useful data (3.1% bus utilization!).

### The Matrix Transpose Case Study

Transposing an $N 	imes N$ matrix requires reading by row (coalesced) and writing by column (uncoalesced):

```cuda
// Optimized Transpose using Shared Memory to Coalesce Both Reads and Writes
#define TILE_DIM 32
#define BLOCK_ROWS 8

__global__ void transpose_coalesced(float* odata, const float* idata, int width, int height) {
    // Pad shared memory by 1 float to eliminate bank conflicts!
    __shared__ float tile[TILE_DIM][TILE_DIM + 1];

    int x = blockIdx.x * TILE_DIM + threadIdx.x;
    int y = blockIdx.y * TILE_DIM + threadIdx.y;

    // Coalesced read from global DRAM into shared memory
    for (int j = 0; j < TILE_DIM; j += BLOCK_ROWS) {
        if (x < width && (y + j) < height) {
            tile[threadIdx.y + j][threadIdx.x] = idata[(y + j) * width + x];
        }
    }

    __syncthreads();

    // Re-index to transpose inside shared memory
    x = blockIdx.y * TILE_DIM + threadIdx.x;
    y = blockIdx.x * TILE_DIM + threadIdx.y;

    // Coalesced write to global DRAM!
    for (int j = 0; j < TILE_DIM; j += BLOCK_ROWS) {
        if (x < height && (y + j) < width) {
            odata[(y + j) * height + x] = tile[threadIdx.x][threadIdx.y + j];
        }
    }
}
```
